title: Achieve playable browser vision
description: Current playtest at http://localhost:5174/ can advance, acknowledge interrupts, reset, copy packets, and autosave, but it stalls after consuming the seeded order queue because the player cannot issue new orders. Finish the next slice by exposing browser order commands, adding order-entry controls, adding manual save/load UI, and surfacing a debrief/outcome flow that reaches the intended Remote Ops vertical-slice vision.

title: Build browser order controls UI
description: Why: the browser shell can advance, acknowledge, reset, and save, but still cannot queue high-level robot orders through the existing gameApi order API.\n\nWhat: add a modest browser shell order-entry panel for selecting a robot and queueing supported high-level orders, refresh autosave and shell state after each action, and surface validation feedback in the existing UI status patterns while preserving current controls.

title: Implement Cloudflare deployment config
description: Add root Wrangler static-assets config, minimal Cloudflare Terraform under infra/terraform, and repo usage scripts/docs for building, Wrangler preview/deploy, and Terraform plan/apply. Validate the web build and a lightweight Wrangler config check if feasible.

title: Implement Remote Ops packets and save payloads
description: Add structured AI-readable packet generation, define the canonical save payload for Remote Ops, add save serialization helpers, and keep replay scaffolding small and deterministic.
notes: Resolved with src/saveCodecs.lib.sigil deriving json for µSaveFile and µReplayLog, while src/types.lib.sigil stays type-only. src/saveApi.lib.sigil now builds canonical payloads, and save/replay codec tests pass under sigil test.

title: Implement Remote Ops simulation loop
description: Create the first deterministic order-processing and interruption loop for Remote Ops. The simulation should advance queued high-level robot orders in atomic steps, update mission metrics, emit event-log entries, and stop on meaningful interrupts rather than forcing one-tile-at-a-time input.

title: Generate first HelixGrid facility slice
description: Implement the first semi-procedural HelixGrid facility generator. The generator should produce the vertical-slice room graph, key room placement, basic tile/security/objective placement, and deterministic variation so the simulation can stop depending on one fully fixed map.

title: Define Remote Ops domain model
description: Establish the deterministic Sigil domain model for Remote Ops. Create the initial canonical types and module surfaces for missions, facilities, robots, parts, objectives, orders, interrupts, meters, and save-friendly state so later simulation and UI work can build on a stable core.

title: Bootstrap Remote Ops foundation
description: Create the initial Sigil project scaffold and the browser shell foundation for Remote Ops. This includes a neutral Sigil root, web app skeleton, generated TypeScript handoff path, and the initial project structure for the vertical slice.
